Deal teams screen many targets but can afford full due diligence on few, and classic advisory ends in a static report.

Investigate in waves, tie every finding to its source, score the competing deal hypotheses (fair terms, hidden liabilities, regulatory risk, overstated synergies) and set a walk-away position.

It draws on these skills: [M&A screening](@/skills/m-and-a-screening.md), [Due diligence](@/skills/due-diligence.md), [Financial statement analysis](@/skills/financial-analysis.md), [Ownership and link analysis](@/skills/ownership-analysis.md), [Market intelligence](@/skills/market-intelligence.md), [Contestable decisions](@/skills/contestable-decisions.md), [Risk scoring](@/skills/risk-scoring.md), [Data room](@/skills/data-room.md) and [Decision support](@/skills/decision-support.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [Phoenix](@/glossary/phoenix.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md) and [Monte Carlo simulation](@/glossary/monte-carlo-simulation.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md) and [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md).

4 public repositories show its skills (4 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
